meta.source: Package-free merge 2026-08-25: PERSOLKELLY annual base / 12 and Adecco monthly salary with stated exclusions are used wherever either covers a guide coordinate. Hays annual total-package evidence is only a temporary fallback where neither package-free source covers that coordinate. Reviewed owner overlays apply afterward.
meta.basis: Mixed monthly calibration, not strict base salary: PERSOLKELLY is annual base / 12; Adecco is monthly salary excluding overtime, commissions, allowances and bonuses; 131 cells are currently attributed solely to Hays annual total-package evidence and remain explicitly non-base-compatible.
meta.converted_from: Mixed annual and monthly source tables, rounded to nearest HK$500; see docs/salary_anchor_compensation_semantics_2026-08-21.md.
meta.seniority_mapping: Analyst/Officer->junior; Associate/AVP/Assistant Manager->mid; VP/SVP/Senior Manager->senior; Director/MD/Head/CxO->lead
meta.usage_note: Default to the modest tier (commercial/retail/middle/back office) when the desk is unclear. Only use front_office bands when the title clearly names an IB/PE/HF/AM/trading/private-banking-RM desk. A salary disclosed in the description always overrides these anchors.
meta.global_max_note: 2026-07-21: every ladder/table upper bound is hard-capped at HK$200,000/month (annual comp caps and open-ended '+' bands removed). The estimator was running ~30% too high in production; this is a deliberate, conservative recalibration.
meta.merge_script: scripts/build_merged_salary_anchors.py --check; use --capture-overrides after reviewed manual edits or --force after intentional source-guide changes
meta.grade_ladder_note: Banking roles use Analyst/Associate/VP/Director/MD rows (PERSOLKELLY year bands: 0-3/3-7/7-10/10+/15+). Insurance roles use Officer-Senior Analyst / AsstMgr-Manager / SrMgr-SrDirector / Head. Roles only covered by one source carry that source's own row labels.
meta.granularity_expansion_2026-08-21: Opus-assisted pass against 2,007 real unresolved live titles (GitHub Actions run 32403056801, 2026-08-20) plus persolkelly_2025.json/adecco_2026.json. 8 items are exact copies of already-published PERSOLKELLY/Adecco cells that were never wired into tables_monthly_hkd (annual->monthly converted where needed, nearest HK$500). The rest are grade rows interpolated from the SAME role's own adjacent wired rows (mostly: AVP sits between Associate and VP, Manager=AVP, Senior Manager=VP, Head of Department=Director, per title_grade_bands_monthly_hkd's own bank equivalences and the pattern 4 roles already had — trade_support and collateral_management match it exactly, risk_credit partially, risk_market not well, so treat these as a reasoned extrapolation, not a fifth published source). 3 low-confidence proposed NEW roles (sales_business_development, strategy_planning, cards_unsecured_lending) were found but deliberately NOT applied — no real source, held back pending one.
meta.relationship_manager_reference_2026_08_2: Owner-provided banking calibration: in Commercial or Corporate Banking, Assistant Relationship Manager = HK$55,000-70,000/month, Relationship Manager = HK$70,000-90,000, Senior Relationship Manager = HK$90,000-150,000. SME and Retail Banking Relationship Manager roles use the same named grades at a 20% discount (HK$44,000-56,000; HK$56,000-72,000; HK$72,000-120,000 respectively). These functional RM titles are not the generic bank Manager/AVP grade.
meta.pricing_test_corrections_2026_08_21: Narrow calibrations from Morris H.'s WhatsApp review of the Pricing Test: private-banking business manager, mortgage team head, investment-management and investment-operations senior manager, strategy/business-design consulting, HKEx exchange operations AVP, insurance underwriting, agency-recruitment director, and insurance AVP.

temporary_hays_only_package_divisor.scope: Direct Hays-only baseline cells; blended and interpolated cells excluded.
temporary_hays_only_package_divisor.rationale: Temporary numerical proxy: Hays 2026 reports total annual package, not base salary.

package_free_merge_2026_08_25.policy: When a guide coordinate has PERSOLKELLY or Adecco evidence, exclude Hays total-package evidence before merging. Preserve Hays only as a fallback when no package-free guide covers the coordinate.

meta.big_four_senior_consultant_technology_20: Owner-calibrated row for a Big Four SENIOR consultant in a technology specialism (cloud security, DevSecOps, cyber, data). The generic senior_consultant band (40,000-55,000) under-reads these: HK tech-advisory hires carry a premium over generic advisory at the same grade. Deliberately wider (1.44x) than a normal grade row because the premium varies by specialism. Provenance is OWNER CALIBRATION, not a published guide row - the same basis the big_four group's docstring already records for parts of this table. Added with the matcher fix that stopped 'Senior <specialism> Consultant' being graded as a plain Consultant (20,000-33,000).

front_office._desc: IB/M&A, PE, hedge funds, asset management, global markets/trading, private banking RMs. Highest pay. Apply ONLY when the title clearly names one of these desks.

commercial_corporate_banking._desc: Corporate / commercial / SME / FI relationship managers, transaction banking, wealth management. Commercial and corporate RM roles use the owner-provided 2026-08-21 bands; SME RM roles use their 20%-discounted counterparts.

retail_banking._desc: Branch, retail relationship management, mortgage, insurance/investment specialists, tellers. Retail RM roles use the owner-provided Commercial/Corporate RM reference less 20%.

middle_office._desc: Risk (credit/market/ops/enterprise), compliance, internal audit, product control, project/change mgmt. Below front office at the same title. Includes legal, company secretarial, IT leadership/governance and cybersecurity at financial firms.

back_office_operations._desc: Treasury / trade / payment / fund / securities operations, KYC / documentation / onboarding, loan admin, settlements. Lowest of the professional bands. Most operational bands share this ladder. Also HR, admin/secretarial, customer service, marketing and hands-on IT/engineering at financial firms.

corporate_finance_accounting._desc: In-house FP&A, controllers, finance managers, tax, treasury, accounting support (commerce & industry + banking-industry finance). Use the modest ladder.

insurance._desc: Actuarial, underwriting, claims, distribution/agency, plus insurance risk/compliance/audit/accounting. Use middle-office-equivalent bands; agency/distribution are often commission-based.

management_grade_caps_monthly_hkd._desc: Deterministic title-grade overrides for banks and big insurance companies, applied on top of (and only ever tightening) the tier/role bands above. Enforced in hk_jobs/salary_clamp.py; rendered into the DeepSeek prompt as soft guidance in hk_jobs/enrichers/deepseek.py.

bank.note: 'Manager' / 'Assistant Manager' titles are treated as the Assistant Vice President grade.

insurance.note: At FWD, Sun Life, and Manulife specifically the seniority order is reversed at the top: Vice President > Assistant Vice President > Director > Associate Director > Senior Manager > Manager. No tighter figure is specified for VP/AVP at these three, so they fall back to global_max_monthly_hkd (200,000).

ambiguous_multi_grade_title_band.evidence: Owner correction, 2026-08-24: compound titles that combine multiple competing grade labels (for example Senior Consultant / Manager / Associate Director) are exceptionally difficult to classify. Use the broad HK$55,000-80,000 range rather than allowing one token to dominate.
ambiguous_multi_grade_title_band.scope: Generic ambiguity protection. Explicit disclosed salary overlays and previously reviewed employer-size function bands remain authoritative.

title_grade_bands_monthly_hkd._desc: Deterministic title-grade BANDS (floor AND ceiling) for banks and insurance companies. Unlike management_grade_caps_monthly_hkd — which only ever lowered a ceiling — a match here is authoritative for the whole range: these grades are the one place where the title is hard evidence and the model's read is not. Enforced in hk_jobs/salary_clamp.py; rendered into the DeepSeek prompt in hk_jobs/enrichers/deepseek.py; applied identically by the /fix-s skill.
title_grade_bands_monthly_hkd._source: Morris H., 2026-08-19 (WhatsApp). Domain expert: worked middle-to-senior grades in both HK banks and insurers. 'These salaries are close to reality.' Supersedes management_grade_caps_monthly_hkd wherever a title matches a grade here.
title_grade_bands_monthly_hkd._not_applied_to: front_office tier (revenue desks run their own, much higher ladder — a trading VP is not an operations VP) and internships (the internship cap wins over every band).
title_grade_bands_monthly_hkd.sme_discount_note: 'Banks and insurance companies are mostly listed multinational corporations, therefore salaries are higher; for smaller/medium corporations apply 30% discount.' Already implemented as salary_clamp.BOUTIQUE_SALARY_MULTIPLIER = 0.7 keyed on jobs.source_tier == 'boutique'. Recorded here so the two cannot drift.

smaller_bank.evidence: Owner and management review of the 1,000-Role salary evaluation, 2026-08-23: CMB Wing Lung must be calibrated as a smaller bank, 20%-30% below the large-bank title bands. The reviewed AVP/Manager example starts from HK$50,000-70,000 and lands at HK$40,000-55,000 after a 20% discount and normal HK$5,000 band rounding.
smaller_bank.reviewed_title_bands_evidence: The same 2026-08-23 review set Product Manager—including Mobile App and generic Product Manager Roles—at HK$45,000-60,000 for banks in this smaller-bank class. Product Manager is a function here, not automatic evidence of Director grade. Team Lead is treated as Senior Manager-or-higher, also HK$45,000-60,000, rather than the large-bank Director band. An unambiguous finance Manager grade is HK$40,000-55,000; a leading 'Manager, …' token is grade evidence, while mixed/lower grades and function-label suffixes such as Customer Service Manager retain their narrower rules. An explicit corporate grade in the title still outranks the functional bands. Follow-up review, 2026-08-23: CMB Intern titles are HK$5,000-15,000, and CMB Trainee/graduate-programme titles are HK$12,000-25,000. Both are deliberately wide because campus compensation varies materially by programme; neither is subject to the smaller-bank discount or the generic internship cap.
smaller_bank.scope: The discount and reviewed title bands apply to estimated monthly base salaries for the exact Employer slugs listed here. They are independent of jobs.source_tier, which describes how a Listing was collected rather than Employer size. Add another bank only after its size classification has been reviewed.

mid_sized_bank_large_department_head.evidence: Owner correction, 2026-08-23: At a reviewed WeLab-sized bank, Head of a substantial bank department is Director-grade. WeLab Bank's active Head of Finance & Treasury was under-priced before this band.
mid_sized_bank_large_department_head.scope: A reusable mid-sized-bank class, not a one-company exception. It applies to the reviewed WeLab-sized bank slugs above and to another bank only after that bank is added to this class. CMB Wing Lung is deliberately excluded because its smaller-bank calibration is lower. It also excludes Customer Service and smaller-team head titles.

bea_sized_bank_functional_assistant_mana.evidence: Owner correction, 2026-08-23: Functional Assistant Manager Roles at BEA-sized banks, including Fund Settlement and MPF Business, should be HK$24,000-40,000 monthly.
bea_sized_bank_functional_assistant_mana.scope: A reusable BEA-sized-bank class. It applies to a functional title of the form Assistant + one or more function words + Manager, such as Assistant Fund Settlement Manager. It excludes plain Assistant Manager, Assistant VP, Assistant to Manager, and non-reviewed employer sizes. Add another bank only after it has been reviewed as BEA-sized.

bank.note: Morris's parenthetical equivalences: Senior Vice President = senior manager / associate director; Vice President = Manager / Senior Manager; Assistant Vice President = Manager. 'Head of' reads as Executive Director or Director depending on which of the two the title names.
bank.exceeds_global_max_note: global_head (300k) and managing_director (250k) sit ABOVE meta.global_max_monthly_hkd (200k). That ceiling exists to stop an unmatched or mis-tiered model estimate drifting up (~30% ran high in production); a deterministic title match at a known bank is categorically different evidence, so these two grades — and ONLY these two, and ONLY on a title match — are allowed past it. Every other path still hard-caps at 200k.

grade_equivalences._source: Morris H., 2026-08-20 (WhatsApp) — a second pass on the titles that confuse the estimator most.
grade_equivalences.division_head: = managing_director. 'Division Head is a big role, equal to Managing Director grade.'
grade_equivalences.team_head: = director. 'Team Head is equal to Director grade.'
grade_equivalences.product_manager: = director only when the independent model estimate already reaches HK$80,000 at the top end. 2026-08-23 management review found that the functional label alone over-promoted ordinary mobile, digital and general Product Manager Roles into HK$100,000-150,000. Below that guardrail the regular coordinate/estimate remains in force; an explicit Director/VP/etc. title still outranks this functional rule.
grade_equivalences.general_manager: = director. 'For Chinese banks they like using General Manager or Deputy GM which is equivalent to Director/Head of, it is a senior role.' CHINESE BANKS ONLY — see chinese_bank_slugs.
grade_equivalences.senior_associate_and_section_head: Morris H., 2026-08-21 (WhatsApp). 'Change Senior Associate to $45k-60k' (a direct correction, superseding the earlier assistant_vice_president-band guess used for jobsdb/93991565). 'Section Head is close to Team Head, close to Associate Director or Director grade' — banded as [associate_director/senior_vice_president floor, director ceiling] = [80000, 150000]; wider than most grades here because three reference points were given rather than one, and averaging them away would discard evidence.

bank.functional_titles_rank_below_grade_words: team_head, general_manager and product_manager are FUNCTIONAL labels, not corporate grades, so they are matched only after the explicit grade words (MD/ED/SVP/AVP/VP/Director). 'Director, Trade Product Manager' is a Director because the title says so; 'ED, Team Head, Client Services' is an Executive Director. The grade word is harder evidence about the HR grade than the function is.
bank.team_head_service_exclusion: A Team Head whose title also names a client-relationship / client-service / customer-service / servicing / support / operations / admin / contact-centre function does NOT take the Director band. This is the one place Morris's rule is not applied wholesale, and it is deliberate: hk_jobs/enrichers/deepseek.py has carried the opposite instruction since v8 for a measured reason — a bank has MANY service/CR team heads at ~50k-100k and few desk heads at 150k+, and pricing the former as Directors is the exact over-estimation that disambiguation was added to stop. 3 of 16 live Team Head rows hit this exclusion. FLAG TO MORRIS.
bank.product_manager_junior_exclusion: Assistant / Junior / Trainee / Graduate Product Manager does not take the Director band. More broadly, a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager title is only allowed to confirm the Director band when its independent raw estimate already has a maximum of at least HK$80,000; this keeps ordinary mobile, digital and general product Roles from being promoted solely by their function label.
bank.chinese_bank_slugs_note: Mainland-Chinese institutions operating in HK. 'bank-of-east-asia' is deliberately NOT here — it is a Hong Kong bank, and Morris scoped the General Manager convention to Chinese banks. It also uses GM titles, so ask him whether it belongs.

insurance.note: The hierarchy is INVERTED relative to banks: at insurers VP and AVP are the TOP grades, not mid-level. The old management_grade_caps table already knew this for FWD/Sun Life/Manulife only; Morris states it as the general insurance rule.
insurance.unmapped_grades_note: No insurance grade is left structurally unmapped. Morris placed Vice President above AVP but supplied no direct VP range, so VP uses a deliberately broad HK$100,000-200,000 safety band: the reviewed AVP floor to the existing global ceiling. This prevents a low functional guide coordinate from pricing the top grade below AVP without pretending to have a precise VP benchmark.
insurance.tier_2_discount_note: 'The index above only applies to Tier 1 groups. For Tier 2 companies apply 15% discount.' Applied to both endpoints only when the Employer slug is explicitly present in tier_2_slugs; absence from Tier 1 is not evidence of Tier 2 membership.
tier_1_not_configured: BOC Group Life Assurance (only the bank, slug 'bochk', is in companies.yaml)
YF Life Insurance (formerly MassMutual Asia) — not in companies.yaml
tier_2_not_configured: Hang Seng Insurance — NOTE: 'hang-seng-bank' is the BANK, not its insurance arm; do NOT map it here or the bank's own jobs get the insurance discount
insurance.tier_2_note: None of Morris's six Tier 2 insurers is currently in companies.yaml, so the 15% discount is inert today. The list is recorded in full so it activates the moment any of them is added.

sun_life_sized_insurer_grades.evidence: Owner correction, 2026-08-23: At a reviewed Sun-Life-sized insurer, Associate Director is HK$60,000-80,000 and Assistant Vice President is HK$120,000-150,000. Every matching Role receives the same grade band regardless of function.
sun_life_sized_insurer_grades.scope: A reusable insurer-size class. It covers all reviewed Sun Life Hong Kong slugs and another insurer only after it is explicitly classified as Sun-Life-sized. It does not change Director, VP, Senior Manager, or other grades.

mid_sized_insurer_senior_manager.evidence: Owner correction, 2026-08-24: Senior Group Manager, IFRS; Senior Manager, Agency Performance Management; and Senior Manager, Partnership Distribution at Prudential Hong Kong should all be treated as Senior Manager-grade at HK$55,000-80,000.
mid_sized_insurer_senior_manager.scope: A reusable insurer-size class. It applies the reviewed Senior Manager band to Prudential-sized insurers only after their slug is explicitly added; Senior Group Manager is included because the reviewed titles use Group as a scope qualifier, not a separate corporate grade.

big_four.label: Big Four professional-services firms

evidence.consultant_or_associate: Glassdoor Hong Kong, reviewed 2026-08-26: Consultant base pay HK$20,000-33,000/month. Hays Advisory Practices is HK$300,000-420,000 annual TOTAL PACKAGE, so it is retained only as a 25,000-35,000 monthly-package sanity envelope, not divided into a base salary.
evidence.senior_associate_or_assistant_manager: Deloitte/EY Glassdoor submissions place Senior Associate around HK$29,000-45,000/month when annual figures are normalized for display. Hays Advisory Practices is a HK$420,000-600,000 annual TOTAL PACKAGE envelope; the published HK$30,000-45,000 band does not use a universal Hays divisor.
evidence.senior_consultant: Owner-reviewed Big Four rule (first recorded for Deloitte) plus eleven current Deloitte board listings with source salary HK$40,000-55,000, including a standalone Senior Consultant. Glassdoor Hong Kong reports Big Four Senior Consultant total-pay ranges around HK$30,000-47,000/month and broad base pay HK$30,000-45,000; the wider reviewed band preserves role uncertainty.
evidence.manager: Owner-reviewed Big Four calibration: HK$50,000-60,000. It also sits inside Hays' total-package Manager envelopes, but is not a Hays /12 or /14 conversion.
evidence.manager_ma: Owner-reviewed Big Four calibration: M&A Manager HK$50,000-90,000. This was first recorded at Deloitte and deliberately applies to EY, KPMG and PwC under the shared-cohort policy.
evidence.senior_manager: Glassdoor Hong Kong, reviewed 2026-08-26: Deloitte Senior Manager base pay HK$72,000-83,000/month (35 submissions, high confidence). Hays Advisory Practices reports HK$840,000-1,200,000 annual TOTAL PACKAGE; HK$70,000-85,000 is a rounded base-pay calibration corroborated by Hays, not a mechanical /12 or /14 conversion.
evidence.associate_director: Owner-reviewed Big Four calibration: HK$85,000-120,000. Hays does not publish a standalone Associate Director row.
evidence.forensics_senior: Owner-reviewed Big Four calibration: Senior Forensics roles HK$40,000-55,000. Hays provides Enterprise Risk / Professional Services package envelopes only, not a standalone forensic-base row.

big_four.policy: Any owner-reviewed salary anchor first recorded for one Big Four firm applies to all four, unless the evidence is explicitly employer-disclosed and tied to one company. Hays total-package figures are service-line sanity envelopes only: no global /12 or /14 conversion is applied to this cohort. Explicit Director, Partner, Principal, Head and VP titles are intentionally not priced by this group because the available evidence is open-ended or insufficiently comparable.

jpmorgan.label: JPMorgan group
jpmorgan.policy: JPMorgan pays above the general bank VP market, but the reviewed HK VP band is HK$85,000-120,000 rather than HK$150,000-171,000.

evidence.digital_mobile_ebanking: Current Hong Kong permanent digital-banking Product Manager advertisement: HK$720,000-780,000 annual (HK$60,000-65,000/month), plus a Digital Product Owner payment advertisement at HK$45,000-65,000/month base. Adecco Hong Kong 2026 IT Product Management is HK$45,000-75,000/month. HK$45,000-65,000 is a deliberately conservative mid-level envelope, not a blanket mobile-app discount.
evidence.cards_lending_deposits: Consumer-banking portfolio roles are heterogeneous. The reviewed HK$45,000-65,000 mid-level band is deliberately shared with ungraded digital/consumer product ownership only; Senior, Lead, regional/global and explicit corporate-grade titles are excluded. No universal /12, /13 or /14 Hays conversion is used.
evidence.cash_transaction: Michael Page Hong Kong 2026 Banking & Financial Services guide (base salary, excluding bonus) lists Transaction Banking Product (Trade/Cash) at HK$550,000 Associate and HK$880,000 VP annually. HK$45,000-75,000 is a broad ungraded default between those published levels. The separately reviewed DBS-scale Cash Product Manager HK$35,000-50,000 rule takes precedence.
evidence.trade_finance: Michael Page Hong Kong 2026 Banking & Financial Services guide (base salary, excluding bonus) lists Transaction Banking Product (Trade/Cash) at HK$550,000 Associate and HK$880,000 VP annually. HK$50,000-75,000 is an ungraded trade-product default; explicit VP/Director, Senior/Lead and mixed-grade titles are excluded rather than compressed into it.
evidence.wealth_investment: Randstad Hong Kong Banking & Financial Services Product Management basic monthly pay excluding AWS/fixed/variable bonus is HK$50,000-60,000 (1-3 years), HK$60,000-90,000 (3-6), HK$90,000-120,000 (7-10) and HK$120,000+ (10+). A current permanent Product Manager/BA investment-platform advertisement is HK$700,000-900,000 annually. HK$55,000-80,000 is an ungraded mid-level default only; explicit seniority and corporate grades are excluded.
evidence.markets_securities_custody: Current permanent Hong Kong Product Manager/BA investment, trading and asset-management advertisement is HK$700,000-900,000 annually (about HK$58,000-75,000/month). HK$55,000-80,000 is a deliberately broad specialist default, not evidence that every markets/custody product title is executive grade.
evidence.governance_proposition_portfolio: Michael Page Hong Kong 2026 Retail Banking guide lists Segmentation & Proposition base salary at HK$400,000 Associate, HK$750,000 VP and HK$1,100,000 Director annually. HK$50,000-75,000 is a broad ungraded governance/proposition/portfolio default; Senior, Lead, Head and formal grades retain their grade paths.
evidence.unresolved_product_domain: Hays 2026 Banking/Middle Office Product Management p.67 establishes only an open-ended annual TOTAL PACKAGE Manager row, so title-only product roles cannot truthfully have a narrow universal base-pay band. HK$45,000-85,000 is a deliberate uncertainty range for an ungraded bank product title with no recognised product-domain signal; it is not a Hays /12, /13 or /14 conversion.

bank_product_management.policy: Applies only when the classifier selected middle_office/product_management and the employer is in the project Banking registry. A literal 'Product Manager' title is not required: a product-function Business Manager or Innovation Manager is eligible only after that classifier decision. Product domain is inferred from title keywords in this order: governance/proposition/portfolio; digital/mobile/e-banking; trade finance; cards/lending/deposits; cash/transaction; wealth/investment; markets/securities/custody; unresolved. Functional responsibility takes precedence over the underlying vertical, so Product Governance for an investment product is governance and e-banking within private banking is digital. The rules are broad ungraded defaults, not corporate grades. They exclude Senior, Lead, Head, Assistant, Associate, graduate/trainee, explicit AVP/VP/Director/MD/ED/Associate Director grades, multi-grade menus, and regional/global/cross-border, enterprise/platform or AI/GenAI scope. Reviewed CMB smaller-bank, DBS-scale cash/senior Product Manager, ICBC digital/solutions Product Manager and HSBC-scale Lead Product rules remain higher priority.

hsbc_sized_banks.label: HSBC-scale banks
hsbc_sized_banks.policy: Lead Product Owner, Lead Product Manager and equivalent product-lead titles at banks of HSBC scale use HK$75,000-100,000. Spread Products Banker at Vice President level uses HK$100,000-125,000 for Citi and comparable HSBC-scale banks; JPMorgan remains on its separate HK$85,000-120,000 VP calibration. Ordinary Product Manager titles are not included.

dbs_sized_banks.label: DBS-scale comparable banks
dbs_sized_banks.policy: At DBS and comparable large retail/corporate banks, Cash Product Manager and Relationship Manager use HK$35,000-50,000, while Senior Product Manager uses HK$80,000-110,000.

market_infrastructure.label: HKEX-scale market-infrastructure firms
market_infrastructure.policy: VP and AVP titles at HKEX and comparable exchange/market-infrastructure firms use the reviewed broad bands.

icbc_sized_banks.label: ICBC-scale Chinese banks
icbc_sized_banks.policy: Senior digital/solutions Product Manager roles at ICBC-comparable banks use HK$70,000-85,000. Global Markets Sales and Global Markets Senior Sales use HK$45,000-55,000; Investment Consultant uses HK$57,000-70,000. CMB Wing Lung remains in its separately reviewed smaller-bank class.

fwd_sized_insurers.policy: At FWD, Director is HK$80,000-110,000, Underwriter is HK$70,000-100,000, and AVP is HK$90,000-150,000. Comparable insurers are added only after their existing reviewed hierarchy is checked. Sun Life and Prudential retain their separately reviewed overrides.

deutsche_bank_mixed_director_vp.policy: A Deutsche Bank title that explicitly combines Director and VP is an ambiguous mixed-grade role and uses HK$70,000-120,000. Standalone Director and VP titles keep their ordinary bands.

title_function_bands_monthly_hkd._desc: Narrow title-and-function corrections from Morris H.'s 2026-08-21 Pricing Test review. Applied before broader bank or insurance corporate-grade bands because these functions have materially different pay from their generic grade.

employer_salary_overlays_monthly_hkd._desc: Evidence-backed employer-and-title salary bands. These are deliberately narrower than the general anchor table: a rule needs an exact company slug plus a title pattern, and overrides the generic boutique multiplier only for that confirmed role. Add a rule only with a documented employer-specific correction; never turn a single correction into a company-wide or title-wide assumption.

rules.evidence: Employer-disclosed range captured from the active CMB Wing Lung eFinancialCareers Listing, 2026-08-23. This exact source fact overrides the generic bank Team Head grade, which materially overstated the role.
rules.scope: Exact CMB Wing Lung title only. The live source disclosure remains the authoritative value if it changes.

rules.title_pattern: ^Assistant Relationship Manager \(Private Banking & Wealth Management Department\)$
rules.evidence: Employer-disclosed range captured from the active CMB Wing Lung eFinancialCareers Listing, 2026-08-23. This exact source fact corrects an over-priced generic private-banking estimate.
rules.scope: Exact CMB Wing Lung title only. The live source disclosure remains the authoritative value if it changes.

rules.evidence: Owner correction, 2026-08-21: Manager-grade roles should not fall below HK$45,000/month. Scoped to A&M's Infrastructure & Capital Projects advisory-manager postings after Project Delivery and Operations was stored at HK$17,500-35,000 solely because the generic boutique multiplier reduced the HK$43,000-60,000 advisory Manager anchor.
rules.scope: Employer + manager title + Infrastructure & Capital Projects function only. It does not apply to other Alvarez & Marsal managers, other boutique employers, or generic Manager titles.

manager_grade_floors_monthly_hkd._desc: Morris H., 2026-08-22: finance Manager-grade roles start at HK$40,000/month at smaller or unclassified firms (HK$40,000-50,000 when the existing estimate is entirely below the floor), and at HK$50,000/month at large employers. This is a floor, not a universal Manager-title band: any title that also names a lower/alternate grade (Assistant, Deputy, Associate, Consultant, Analyst, Officer, Trainee, etc.), Relationship Manager, or service/support/HR/marketing/administration function is excluded because it does not establish the unambiguous finance Manager grade Morris described. Relationship Manager has its own owner-provided Commercial/Corporate and SME/Retail bands. The floor applies to recognised finance salary coordinates only; unknown classifications fail open rather than guessing a promotion.

large_employer.membership_note: All configured banks and insurers are also treated as large employers in hk_jobs.salary_clamp.py. This short list records the additional large asset managers, HKEx and Big Four firms; source_tier is deliberately not used because it describes the scraper route, not employer size.

role_table_semantics._desc: Generated role-table contract. grade_ladder rows may be selected by the explicit seniority_to_grade map; title_catalog row order has no meaning and requires an exact coordinate.
